pulse.currentFocus: Session 333 restored The Desk to live publishing after a six-day, nine-run outage, and it took two independent fixes stacked in sequence. Topic selection gave up after one topic whose only direct source answered 401 while six readable topics sat untried; that repair then exposed a second failure it had been masking, where the managed inference provider had retired the pinned authoring model while still advertising it. The session also wired a regression self-test that had never been invoked by any runner into build:check, generalized its single-script assertion into a structural invocation-mode detector, repaired a public forge ledger that was publishing zero entries because a fixed 120-commit scan window had been buried by automation churn, and added consecutive-unknown streak plus last-known-good age to canonical destination evidence.
pulse.nextMilestone: Confirm unattended scheduled Desk runs keep landing editions, thread the authoring-model fallback into published story provenance, extend check-build-gate-reachability to every self-test-bearing module, and complete the founder-reserved Obelisk relying-party/passkey ceremony when available.
blockers: identity/auth surfaces remain held on real-provider-e2e-pending: obelisk.identity.verify is missing OBELISK_RP_ID, OBELISK_RP_NAME, and OBELISK_RP_ORIGIN; obelisk-staging-registration is also missing. The S332 candidate is blast-radius-disjoint and its scoped production resolver is allowed, which does not resolve or bypass this hold.

identity: the provider chain is live and verified (discovery JSON, authorize redirect, JWKS, and the revocation route all answer correctly as of session 321). The production promotion is held only on the real-provider journey, whose remaining leg is a founder passkey ceremony — hardware-key enrollment is founder-reserved by CANON-019 and is deliberately not automatable.
rollback architecture: the GitHub Pages warm origin still follows mutable main; D-S303 requires explicit founder authorization before migrating to an immutable verified generation.
IGNIS freshness: stale in a studio-ops portfolio artifact this repo cannot write; resolve upstream rather than backdating.
The Dispatch has zero confirmed subscribers until the founder clicks the double-opt-in confirmation email.

now: [S333][NEWS/P1] Decide whether to loosen topic clustering so corroboration and readability can meet. Measured: 215 topics yielded 2 readable-and-corroborated, 119 corroborated-but-unreadable, 87 readable-but-single-outlet. Those last two populations largely cover the same stories; they do not merge because `clusterItems` compares headlines at a 0.34 similarity threshold and outlets word the same story differently. Merging them converts unusable breadth into publishable topics without relaxing any editorial standard — but a looser threshold risks merging distinct stories, which is what S329 tightened dedupe to prevent. Evaluate with the new `--scan` supply-shape cross-tab as the before/after measure, and consider matching on entities/URLs rather than headline words.
[S333][NEWS/P2] Four new readable feeds are on probation — verify they earn their place. the-decoder, MarkTechPost,
next: [NEXT][SIL][NEWS/AI/P1] Claim-evidence relationship map + agent critique packet. Add stable fact rows and validated factRefs joining factual evidence to stances and visual anchors; publish a per-story public-safe argument map and one-click critique packet with no runtime model spend.

[NEXT][SIL][OBS/P1] Field-vitals freshness closure. Surface observed-through/stale-days, restore a fresh post-S262 RUM window, and bind cohort verdicts to a release SHA so fresh generatedAt can never imply fresh field evidence.
